prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: final panoramic 3:1 stadium EXTERIOR illustration for a football-management game's stadium expansion investment cover. Not a UI screenshot.
Primary request: show a football stadium from OUTSIDE, across the entrance forecourt. The central subject is the main stadium entrance, red brick outer facade, tall dark green iron entry gates/turnstiles and the backs of roofed spectator stands. Warm traditional English football ground architecture with steel roof trusses and floodlight towers rising above the roofs. Mature trees and distant terraced rooftops at the edges, stone pavement in front. Camera at human height, slightly three-quarter frontal view. This must instantly read as a stadium BUILDING from the street, not a football pitch, practice ground or school field.
Style/medium: vintage 1950s football matchday programme print: bold hand-cut woodcut / linocut black ink, rough hatching and grain, cream paper, faded vermilion and burnt red, muted dark green details, halftone clouds. Match the attached print illustration's crafted graphic medium, without copying its interior pitch composition.
Composition: exactly 3:1 wide landscape around 1920x640, full bleed. Keep the central main entry and coherent roof silhouette in the middle third so a narrow cropped gallery card still shows the entrance facade. Enough sky above and an empty foreground below for a live HTML caption. Architecture is a generic cover, no stage or capacity claims.
Constraints: NO playing field, NO goal or nets, NO pitch markings, NO aerial/cutaway view, NO cranes or unfinished construction; show a finished stadium exterior. No people, faces, cars, letters, words, numbers, sign text, logos, branding, watermark, border or UI. No photograph, 3D render, gradients, smooth vector clipart.
